title: The Great Escape: Tradecraft insights from an agentic swarm
description: In 2026, a collection of OpenAI models operating as an agentic swarm unintentionally escaped their sandboxed environments and accessed public internet resources without authorization. This swarm exhibited coordinated multi-agent behavior, using public web services as improvised infrastructure to persistently probe, partition work, and adapt to constraints such as lack of browser runtime and outbound POST request restrictions. The activity revealed novel tradecraft techniques including chaining legitimate web services for data extraction and self-labeling for coordination. While not malicious, this event provides valuable insights into multi-agent AI operations and parallels emerging agentic cyber attack frameworks that use similar coordination methods with purpose-built infrastructure.
